review_scope: Channel virtual-persona eligibility only; no debut date changes or persona merges.

rows.label: Asatsuyu Ch.
rows.evidence_summary: Channel About identifies Asatsuyu as a rabbit maid presented as a VTuber, and links the matching Asatsuyu_CH profile.

rows.label: Chana チャナ
rows.evidence_summary: Channel About introduces Chana as an Online Station betta-fish VTuber, with Chana-specific stream and art tags.
rows.decision_reason: Individual named persona on this channel; affiliation does not make it an agency host account.

rows.label: NEMI
rows.evidence_summary: NEMI About lists drawing, model rigging and singing. The uploader-owned teaser links its own debut; teaser, debut and pudding performance consistently identify NEMI with VTUBER tags and NEMI012 links. The performance distinguishes NEMI from other group members.
rows.decision_reason: Multiple consistent own-persona presentations across uploads establish virtual performance in addition to art/rigging; not inferred from production credits alone.

rows.label: Rainnie Rgrada Ch.
rows.evidence_summary: About introduces Rainnie as a girl from Rgrada, a RiFF Studio brand ambassador who performs as a VTuber, including acting, singing, dance and games.
rows.decision_reason: Direct self-description of Rainnie as the virtual performer; brand affiliation is not evidence of a project-only account.

rows.label: SE1 Ch.
rows.evidence_summary: About introduces Shiai Seiki and explicitly states Thai VTuber.
rows.decision_reason: Channel-level self-identification establishes the individual virtual creator.

rows.label: Tora Mochizuki
rows.evidence_summary: About identifies Tora Mochizuki as the butler persona. Two uploader-owned karaoke/game streams consistently use Tora identity, VTuber tags, matching social links and separate other-channel sections.
rows.decision_reason: Repeated self-presentation by the same uploader across distinct streams, rather than a guest appearance or one tagged clip.

rows.label: Ume Ch. しのはな❀梅
rows.evidence_summary: About identifies Shinohana Ume and credits her own model art and a separate Live2D parent. A later own stream explicitly introduces Ume as VtuberTH; the final stream describes her history as a virtual performer.
rows.decision_reason: Explicit first-person performer description supports both virtual-creator and artist roles. Graduation does not negate historical virtual activity.

rows.label: 久檻夜くぅ / Qualia Qu Ch.
rows.evidence_summary: About identifies Qu Qualia as an ice-fairy VTuber in Japanese, English and Thai and links her own profile separately from Re:AcT.
rows.decision_reason: Explicit self-description of one virtual persona; agency links do not turn this into the agency account.
